# VisionOps — Kubernetes Consulting & DevOps Services

> VisionOps is a Kubernetes and DevOps consulting company based in the Czech Republic. We specialize in production Kubernetes cluster implementation, OpenShift administration, cloud migration, CI/CD automation, and infrastructure monitoring. We serve businesses looking for container orchestration expertise, both on-premises and in the cloud.

- Website: https://visionops.cz
- Contact: info@visionops.cz
- Location: Czech Republic
- Languages: Czech, English

---

## About VisionOps

VisionOps is a team of Kubernetes and OpenShift specialists in the Czech Republic. We help businesses implement container orchestration solutions, migrate to the cloud, and manage production platforms — on-premises and in the cloud. We offer DevOps consulting and complete support from design to operations.

### Why Choose VisionOps

- **Kubernetes expertise** — Years of hands-on experience with production clusters
- **Proven solutions** — DevOps practices that actually work in real-world environments
- **Knowledge transfer** — We hand over complete know-how to your team
- **Flexibility** — On-prem, cloud, or hybrid — we adapt to your infrastructure

---

## Services

### 1. OpenShift & Kubernetes Consulting
https://visionops.cz/sluzby/openshift-konzultace/

Production Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters on-premises (bare metal, Proxmox) and in the cloud (Azure Red Hat OpenShift, AKS), from architecture to handover.

What we deliver:
- Architecture design: cluster topology, node sizing, OVN-Kubernetes networking, storage and high availability
- Installation and configuration: identity provider, RBAC, network policies, image registry
- GitOps with ArgoCD (App of Apps pattern)
- CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CE, GitHub Actions and Tekton
- Security hardening: SecurityContextConstraints, OPA Gatekeeper, Trivy image scanning, Vault
- Observability: OpenTelemetry Collector, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger, Grafana Beyla

### 2. Proxmox VE Virtualization & VMware Migration
https://visionops.cz/sluzby/proxmox-virtualizace/

Open-source enterprise virtualization without license fees, and planned migration away from VMware vSphere/ESXi.

What we deliver:
- Highly available Proxmox VE clusters (Corosync, Ceph, NFS or iSCSI shared storage, VLANs)
- Proxmox Backup Server with deduplicated backups, retention and off-site replication
- VMware to Proxmox migration with minimal downtime
- Network design: bridges, bonds, VLANs, Open vSwitch, cluster firewall
- Proxmox as a foundation for OpenShift/Kubernetes, provisioned with Ansible or Terraform

### 3. CI/CD Automation & GitOps
https://visionops.cz/sluzby/cicd-gitops/

Automated delivery from commit to production with Git as the single source of truth.

What we implement:
- ArgoCD in production-grade configuration (App of Apps, multi-cluster, SSO)
- Self-hosted GitLab CE with CI runners and registries
- Tekton pipelines, Triggers and Chains
- Infrastructure as Code with Ansible, Terraform and Helm
- Blue-green and canary deployments with automated rollbacks
- Pipeline security: Trivy/Grype scanning, SAST, secret scanning, SBOM, Cosign signing

### 4. Monitoring & Observability
https://visionops.cz/sluzby/monitoring-observability/

Metrics, logs and traces across infrastructure, platform and applications.

Monitoring stack we deploy:
- Prometheus, Alertmanager and Grafana; Thanos or Grafana Mimir for long-term storage
- Grafana Loki for logs, shipped by Grafana Alloy or OpenTelemetry Collector
- Grafana Tempo or Jaeger for distributed tracing
- OpenTelemetry Collector as a vendor-neutral telemetry pipeline
- Grafana Beyla (OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation) for instrumentation without code changes
- Zabbix for low-level infrastructure monitoring
- Anomaly detection and SLO-based alerting

---

## Case Study

### Zentity: OpenShift on Proxmox
https://visionops.cz/reference/zentity-openshift-proxmox/

Proxmox VE cluster with Ceph and Proxmox Backup Server as the virtualization layer for a production OpenShift 4.x cluster. Delivered with ArgoCD GitOps, self-hosted GitLab CE CI, Ansible provisioning and a full observability stack (OpenTelemetry Collector, Grafana Beyla, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Zabbix).

## How We Work

Our engagement follows a proven 5-step process:

1. **Assessment** — Thorough analysis of your current infrastructure state, identifying bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

2. **Solution Design** — Custom architecture tailored to your specific needs, business requirements, and existing technology stack.

3. **Implementation** — Building the solution using Infrastructure as Code, automation, and industry best practices. No shortcuts.

4. **Knowledge Transfer** — Complete handoff including training sessions, documentation, and operational procedures for your team.

5. **Ongoing Support** — We remain available for consulting and support after go-live, ensuring smooth operations.
